judgment_refs.phrase: Overtake and pass a motor vehicle
judgment_refs.note: Verify the qualifying rider and motor-vehicle classes and an original behind-to-clear-ahead pass.

judgment_refs.phrase: safely without endangering himself or herself or the occupants of the motor vehicle
judgment_refs.note: Measure the full-body gap, closing motion, passing side and occupant evidence over the whole pass; no numeric legal threshold is supplied.

sweep_specs.rationale: Full-body pass and relative motion are measured, but the legal safety/endangerment conclusion requires source review.
missing_inputs: Original Native rider and motor class and camera visibility
Independent occupant and legal endangerment judgment
